### Routing details

- `agent-governance-steward`: invoke for material-task governance and closeout;
  do not invoke for simple read-only questions.
- `safe-refactor-test-guardian`: invoke for classification code changes;
  do not invoke for read-only discussion.
- `dataset-contract-leakage-guard`: invoke for data, folds, X schema;
  do not invoke for unrelated tracking.
- `experiment-lineage-reproducibility`: invoke for model run/resume;
  do not invoke for prose planning.
- `scientific-ablation-controller`: invoke for ablation/promotion;
  do not invoke for fixed smoke.
- `multimodal-sequence-model-builder`: invoke for model modules and modes;
  do not invoke for dataset-only audit.
- `grouped-cv-evaluation`: invoke for OOF or prediction comparison;
  do not invoke for model construction.
- `tracking-experiment-guardian`: invoke for tracking work;
  do not invoke for classification.
- `imbalanced-classification-evaluator`: invoke for post-pilot loss audit;
  do not invoke for pre-pilot work.
- `gpu-training-profiler`: invoke for post-pilot GPU profiling;
  do not invoke for CPU-only data audit.
- `thesis-evidence-writing`: invoke for thesis workflow;
  do not invoke for code/data/model changes.
- `project-state-steward`: invoke for memory, workflow, and repo closeout;
  do not invoke for trivial questions.

## Dependency Order

Use the first six skills in routing order for a new classifier change.
tracking-experiment-guardian independently routes tracking work to its
required supporting skills and fail-closed gates. Future skills may be invoked
explicitly only after a one-fold pilot.

Shared deterministic resources:

- [templates](templates)
- [read-only checks](checks)
- [synthetic examples](examples)
- [machine routing contract](skill_registry.json)

No skill authorizes full OOF, edits raw data, or changes the scientific target.
